tool.name: NanoClaw
tool.description: Lightweight OpenClaw alternative that runs each personal agent in its own container, messaged from WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and more.
strengths: Built on Claude Agent SDK, Codex optional
tool.pricing: Free and open source; you bring your own model provider account.
tool.practitionerNote: A good fit when you want an OpenClaw-style assistant with a smaller surface and OS-level isolation. The docs note the sandbox is 'not a guarantee that every action is safe', so mount only the folders each agent needs.

dataResidency.detail: Runs on the operator's own computer; cloud model providers still process the requests sent to them.

deployment.detail: Self-hosted on macOS, Linux or WSL2 with Docker containers per agent.

auditLogging.detail: No audit logging documented on the pages reviewed.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Self-hosted open-source agent runtime, not an AI system placed on the market by the maintainer; obligations rest with the deployer.
